patch.value: Research source: official Home Assistant Core 2026.8.0 trace WebSocket implementation plus the public WebSocket API protocol. Scope: typed trace list get and context discovery for automation and script domains; deterministic bounded output; explicit identifiers for exact trace retrieval; generic ws call remains the forward-compatible escape hatch. Safety: all commands are read-only and live evidence persists only redacted schemas counts and booleans. Breakpoint mutation and runtime debug controls are intentionally excluded pending a separate safety design.
Expose the stable Home Assistant automation and script trace contracts through typed bounded CLI commands for execution diagnosis and agent workflows.

Typed hassio ws traces list get and contexts commands validate automation and script domains before network I/O; List and context output is deterministic bounded countable and available in all six supported formats while exact get preserves the Core payload; Detailed nested help machine schema capability probes README and every relevant docs page stay synchronized; Built and installed hassio commands pass local Core live read-only acceptance without persisting private values; Build typecheck lint docstrings duplication file-size ShellCheck audit Trivy PM changelog auto-release dry-run package smoke and exact 100/100/100/100 coverage gates pass
Official Core 2026.8.0 contracts inspected; local Core 2026.7.4 capability proven; all-status PM searches and duplicate scan found no existing trace item; repository is clean on a dedicated branch.
Let operators and LLM agents explain why automations and scripts ran failed or stopped without manually composing WebSocket payloads.
Faster incident diagnosis with token-bounded machine-readable evidence and safer read-only defaults.
Current and backward-compatible trace discovery and retrieval with complete production evidence.
Core 2026.8.0 confirms stable trace contracts and the CLI just completed typed automation runtime execution but lacks the corresponding diagnosis path.
